description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the Module Giga FLOPs for different module types across three Audio back-end Conformer Stages. The horizontal category axis, labeled "Audio back-end Conformer Stage", displays three sequential stages: "Stage 1 (d=180, n=500)", "Stage 2 (d=256, n=250)", and "Stage 3 (d=360, n=125)". The vertical value axis is labeled "Module Giga FLOPs" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.3. Numeric tick labels are provided at 0, 0.2, and 0.3, with a horizontal gridline at the 0.1 interval where the text label is obscured by a small grey rectangle. For each stage on the horizontal axis, there is a group of four side-by-side bars representing different module types, as indicated by the legend at the top. The modules are "attention" (blue), "grouped attention (g=3)" (red), "patch attention (k=3)" (yellow), and "feed-forward" (green). In Stage 1, the blue attention bar is the tallest in the chart at approximately 0.275, followed by grouped attention at roughly 0.16, feed-forward at 0.13, and patch attention at 0.12. In Stage 2, the values are approximately 0.16 for attention, 0.12 for grouped attention, 0.105 for patch attention, and 0.13 for feed-forward. In Stage 3, attention is at 0.12, grouped attention is at 0.105, patch attention is the shortest bar in the chart at approximately 0.10, and feed-forward is at 0.13. The green feed-forward bars maintain a consistent height of approximately 0.13 across all three stages. The groups are ordered sequentially by stage number, and within each group, the bars follow the order presented in the legend without any specific visual emphasis.
